attempt_prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a single horizontal sprite strip of EXACTLY EIGHT evenly spaced frames, one row, left to right, of the WALK cycle. Image 1 is the exact native S2 Sonic eight-frame pose sequence, enlarged nearest-neighbour: copy ONLY each phase's body mechanics, foot alternation, arm swing, head bob, and pose ordering. Image 2 is MICA, an ORIGINAL female pangolin, jade overlapping scales forming a hood, cream muzzle and belly, small ears, white gloves, coral red hiking boots, long tapering scaled tail. Image 3 is approved native-pose MICA sprite art, the rendering/proportion style anchor. Redraw every native pose as MICA: new drawing, never recolour, no Sonic features or spikes. Keep MICA identical in proportions, head, hood, boots, tail across all eight frames. Two legs and two arms; alternate near/far foot after frame four. No duplicates: match reference phase by phase. 16-bit pixel sprite style with crisp blocks and limited jade/cream/coral palette, dark ink contours, no gradients. Each frame occupies one eighth of image, full figure, generous empty margin, no overlap, right-facing side view, constant baseline, no text or borders. Transparent background. This is the complete connected walk cycle, not unrelated character poses.
